description: A cold living room with wooden floors.  Bookshelves line the walls.

exits.description: A heavy wooden front door, weathered by the storm. The iron handle is cold to the touch.
A heavy oak door leading to the study.
A wooden staircase ascends into shadows, the banister worn smooth by years of use. The steps groan under any weight.
A classic double swinging door with a small round window, gently swaying.

items.name: fireplace
items.description: A stone fireplace, cold and dark. A pile of ash sits in the hearth. A poker rests against the hearth, waiting to stir the embers.

items.name: Painting
items.description: A painting hang above the mantlepiece.   in a silver frame. A family stands in front of this very house, smiling.

items.name: grandfather_clock
items.description: An old grandfather clock ticks steadily in the corner. It is tall  with an intricately carved wooden face. The pendulum swings steadily. The glass door is slightly ajar.

items.name: Worn Leather Armchair
items.description: A faded leather armchair sits before the cold hearth, its cracked surface bearing the dark stains of countless restless nights. The cushion sinks slightly.

items.name: Dusty Bookshelf
items.description: A large oak bookshelf overflowing with ancient texts. One book appears slightly crooked.

items.name: Dining table
items.description: A dinner table with 4 sets of porselain plates and cuttlery, 4 chairs around the table.

items.name: Letters
items.description: Several letters adressed to sir Valerius

items.name: cabinet_key
items.description: A small brass key with a faded label: 'PANTRY'. It looks like it would fit the kitchen cabinet lock.

items.name: Coats
items.description: 3 sets of winter coats hanging by the entrace door

name: Living Room
